title: Ending a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement: Move-Out Notice, Vacate and Deposit Release
content:
**Who ends the agreement.** Only the tenant can end a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement: the tenant gives a move-out notice naming a planned vacate date, which is recorded as a received notice and moves the rental to moving out.

**Notice period.** The planned vacate date is at least the class's notice period in calendar days after the notice date; an earlier date asked for is set to the notice date plus that notice period.

**Final rent.** Rent for a billing period that starts before the planned vacate date is owed in full. Where the class credits unused days, the unused days of the final charged period after the vacate date are credited as the monthly rent times the unused days divided by the days in that period, rounded to the cent; where it does not, no part of a period is refunded.

**Vacate.** The vacate is recorded only for a rental whose move-out notice is in received status. If the walk-through finds belongings or debris, the class's cleaning fee is posted; if the tenant lock is still on, the lock is cut and the class's fee for a lock left on is posted.

**Deposit and credit balance.** The security deposit is released within the class's deposit release period after the vacate date: first applied to any balance due, and the remainder refunded. A credit balance left after the deposit is refunded within the class's credit-balance refund period by the original payment method, or by mailed check when that method can no longer be credited.

**Withdrawal.** A notice may be withdrawn by the tenant before the vacate is recorded; the rental returns to active if nothing is past due and to delinquent otherwise.

## Notice-date examples (hypothetical)

| Class notice period | Notice date | Vacate date asked for | Planned vacate date set |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 days | 5 June | 5 June | 5 June |
| 10 days | 5 June | 9 June | 15 June |
| 30 days | 5 June | 20 July | 20 July |

## Proration worked through (hypothetical class that credits unused days)
Monthly rent $300.00; final charged period 1 to 30 June (30 days); vacate date 21 June. Unused days after the vacate date are 22 to 30 June, 9 days. Credit: $300.00 times 9 divided by 30, which is $90.00.

## Deposit worked through (hypothetical)
Deposit held $100.00, balance due $35.00 at vacate: $35.00 is applied to the balance and $65.00 is refunded. With a deposit of $50.00 and a balance due of $80.00, the whole $50.00 is applied and $30.00 stays owed.
